column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured BY NAME in the job's own environment (CLEAT_TEST_DB set, CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset), not from a delta and not with all three DSNs set, where it reads zero: skipped {mysql,mssql}, passed /postgres and TestTheStreamChunkTailReturnsItsConnection. Guards cleat#1639: LoadStreamChunksAfter is the read a reader on a worker NOT executing the run follows it by, so it must be an exclusive cursor on every dialect -- an inclusive one re-sends the last chunk on every poll and reaches a browser as a stuttering transcript rather than an error. All three dialects were run locally and pass, including MSSQL's OFFSET/FETCH paging and MySQL's LIMIT ?; only CI's postgres-only jobs skip two of them.
